body: Kodak Black stopped by his longtime attorney Bradford Cohen’s house to spend some time with him Cohen has known Yak since he was a teenager and has represented him through several legal battles. Over the years, he’s also spoken about a side of Kodak that fans don’t always get to see, including the ways he’s helped people without making it public. After all those years of knowing each other, it’s good to see them just sitting around the kitchen and laughing together.
